title: Chocolate Souffle
hookLine: France-inspired chocolate souffle with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7 and place a baking tray on the top shelf. For the sauce, heat the cream and sugar until boiling. Remove from the heat, stir in the chocolate and butter until melted, then keep warm. Incorporate {m52905_1}, {m52905_2}, {m52905_3}, and {m52905_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure single cream first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Brush 6 x 150ml ramekins with melted butter, sprinkle with the 2 tbsp caster sugar, then tip out any excess. Melt the chocolate and cream in a bowl over a pan of simmering water, cool, then mix in the egg yolks. Whisk the egg whites until they hold their shape, then add the sugar, 1 tbsp at a time, whisking back to the same consistency. Mix a spoonful into the chocolate, then gently fold in the rest. Incorporate {m52905_5}, {m52905_6}, {m52905_7}, {m52905_8}, {m52905_9}, {m52905_10}, {m52905_11}, and {m52905_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Working quickly, fill the ramekins, wipe the rims clean and run your thumb around the edges. Turn oven down to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6, place the ramekins onto the baking tray, then bake for 8-10 mins until risen with a slight wobble. Don’t open the oven door too early as this may make them collapse.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Once the soufflés are ready, dust with icing sugar, scoop a small hole from their tops, then pour in some of the hot chocolate sauce. Replace the lids and serve straight away.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
